name: brewery
description: Brewery's pipeline: distill a request into a signed-off IP, cut it from the requester's side, barrel it tests-first through Pick and Roast to a PR, and finish it to green CI. pour does all of that in one shot for small features. tap takes issues straight to a fixed, green PR. harvest sweeps and labels a repo's issues daily with human sign-off; polish drives your broken PRs to mergeable. rack pulls terreno's skill changes into brewery. recipe shapes a Linear project from the repo's context, taking a Claude Design in or sending a design brief out, and hands its milestones to distill, pour, or tap. install sets up the plugin, CLI, and a repo; overview says which skill to use.

interface.shortDescription: Distill, barrel, tap, and finish work to green PRs; harvest issues and polish PRs daily; recipe Linear projects
